title: Distributed Multimodal Monitoring and Prediction for PV Asset and Site Conditions
abstract: arXiv:2611.28034v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Utility-scale photovoltaic (PV) monitoring remains fragmented: electrical performance, structural condition and vegetation management are typically assessed through separate workflows, making it difficult to relate changes in energy performance to the local physical and environmental conditions experienced by individual modules. We propose a distributed multimodal monitoring and prediction framework that combines mechanical, optical, electrical, and microclimate measurements at the string level. Rather than treating these measurements as independent sensor streams, the framework uses them to derive higher-level indicators of asset and site condition, including quantities that are not directly instrumented. We designed and installed four compact wireless nodes attached directly to the rear of PV modules for a three-month pilot study to demonstrate module-level monitoring. translated_title: 面向光伏资产与场地条件的分布式多模态监测与预测
translated_abstract: 公用事业级光伏（PV）监测目前仍然较为碎片化：电气性能、结构状况和植被管理通常通过各自独立的工作流程进行评估，这使得难以将能量性能的变化与单个组件所经历的局部物理和环境条件联系起来。我们提出了一种分布式多模态监测与预测框架，该框架在组串级别结合了机械、光学、电气和微气候测量。该框架并非将这些测量视为相互独立的传感器数据流，而是利用它们推导出资产和场地状况的更高层次指标，包括那些未直接安装传感器的量。我们设计并安装了四个直接附着在光伏组件背面的紧凑型无线节点，并开展了为期三个月的试点研究以展示组件级监测。通过低成本的多模态测量，该系统检测到了植被……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种在组串级别融合机械、光学、电气和微气候测量的分布式多模态监测与预测框架，通过附着于光伏组件背面的低成本紧凑无线节点实现组件级监测，并能推导出未直接安装传感器的资产与场地状况指标。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a distributed multimodal monitoring and prediction framework that fuses mechanical, optical, electrical, and microclimate measurements at the string level, using compact low-cost wireless nodes attached to the rear of PV modules to enable module-level monitoring and derive higher-level asset and site condition indicators, including quantities not directly instrumented.
